_about: Public-domain Richard Smalbroke (1672-1749), Bishop of St David's and then of Lichfield and Coventry, for the Word Hoard: A Vindication of the Miracles of Our Blessed Saviour (his answer to Woolston), Idolatry Charged upon Arianism, his charges to the clergy of St David's, and sermons. The New Arian Reprov'd and the Enquiry into the Complutensian New Testament were published anonymously and are held until Adam rules on catalogue attributions. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 135 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
